name: run_color_test
purpose: Build the color-RAM test palettes and patterns, display the Color Test screen, and wait for advance

name: os_selftest_loop
purpose: Run the repeating OS diagnostic sequence and optional game test hooks
arguments: one mode long supplied by 0x0E14 but not read by this body
exceptional_convention: normal call entry whose control graph loops forever instead of executing RTS

name: display_init_clear
purpose: Clear alpha and playfield display memory, reset the MOB list heads, and initialize diagnostic colors

name: run_alpha_test
purpose: Populate the alpha display with word and large-glyph test patterns and wait for advance

name: run_motion_object_test
purpose: Create and interactively edit the Motion Object Test sprites, fields, and palettes

name: validate_game_rom
purpose: Call the optional game ROM/Slapstic verifier and display its failed bank checks
return: D0.l = 1 when valid, 0 after displaying a failure

name: run_sound_test
purpose: Reset, diagnose, and interactively exercise the sound CPU, music, effects, and speech paths
